messages.text:
The source and live runs expose one important impossibility: the official binary prints wall-clock duration, and two identical official invocations already differ.

So exact byte equality including that line is not achievable by any independent implementation; the balanced target is matching status, stderr, result line, argument behavior, and the same duration format.

{"command":"python - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib, binascii
for p in pathlib.Path('rust-reference/test-files').glob('*.zip'):
    data=p.read_bytes(); print('---',p)
    off=data.find(b'PK\x03\x04')
    while off!=-1:
        sig,ver,flag,cm,mt,md,crc,cs,us,nl,xl=struct.unpack_from('<IHHHHHIIIHH',data,off)
        name=data[off+30:off+30+nl]
        extra=data[off+30+nl:off+30+nl+xl]
        start=off+30+nl+xl
        print(name, 'flag',flag,'cm',cm,'cs',cs,'extra',binascii.hexlify(extra),'payload_head',binascii.hexlify(data[start:start+32]))
        off=data.find(b'PK\x03\x04', start+cs)
PY","workdir":"C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura_workspace\target\project-rebuild-source-port\r-91263e5c39\zip-password-finder\tura-direct-3\workspace","timeout_ms":15000}
